about.en: AMZNon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by AMZN shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xbb8774FB97436d23d74C1b882E8E9A69322cFD31, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
